artifacts.purpose: Companion setup metadata linking to the source contract.
artifacts.schema: DATA.md and the source initializer, when present.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Companion discovery and restore instructions.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recreate from current source documentation.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only the minimal current setup instructions and exclusions; replace obsolete copies.

artifacts.purpose: Product identity, content constraints and global send gate.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: skills/promotion-assistant/scripts/config.py, compliance checks and frozen run scope.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the approved private configuration.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current product definition while campaigns, compliance or recovery depend on it.

artifacts.purpose: Registered channel identities and per-channel authorization references.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Channel selection, capability doctor and frozen run scope.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore reviewed channel identities; revalidate credentials independently.

retention_rule.rule: Keep current channels and any identities needed to reconcile outstanding runs.

artifacts.purpose: Per-channel pacing and throttle rules.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Admission, cooldown and warmup calculations.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the approved rules without resetting live throttle state.

retention_rule.rule: Keep policies for active channels and unresolved runs.

artifacts.purpose: Private audience definitions and addressed recipient segments.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Campaign planning; addressed dispatch requires segments containing recipient and recipient_country.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore private definitions; never invent recipient rows during migration.

retention_rule.rule: Keep definitions used by current campaigns. Remove obsolete segments only after outstanding frozen runs and consent obligations are accounted for.

artifacts.purpose: Approved campaign arms and content.
artifacts.producer: Companion maintainer and approved content workflow.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: skills/promotion-assistant/scripts/runs.py and campaign planning.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the selected private campaign version.

retention_rule.rule: Keep selected campaigns and arms referenced by retained runs or observations; retire unused drafts after review.

artifacts.purpose: Lawful-basis and withdrawal records.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Dispatch and resume eligibility checks.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the full required sequence so the latest decision is preserved.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while any addressed activity or continuing compliance obligation depends on the records. Never delete a withdrawal to enable sending.

artifacts.purpose: Recipient exclusions.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Every dispatch and resume eligibility check.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore current exclusions before enabling addressed activity.

retention_rule.rule: Keep applicable exclusions while the product may contact those recipients; retire only when the corresponding contact activity and obligations end.

artifacts.purpose: Delivery outcomes and observations used by attribution and learning.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Metrics views, bandit learning and retained run reconciliation.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore required event IDs and their matching run decisions.

retention_rule.rule: Keep events required for current posterior state, deduplication, selected metrics or unresolved outcomes. Retire only after those dependencies are explicitly ended or replaced by a validated sufficient state.

artifacts.purpose: Would-send payloads and eligibility from previews.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The active campaign review or a specifically selected diagnostic.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Regenerate from approved inputs when exact historical payload evidence is not required.

retention_rule.rule: Remove completed previews after their review or diagnosis ends and no retained run or selected deliverable references them.

artifacts.purpose: Posterior state and credited observation identities.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Future campaign selection and idempotent learning.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the state with required credited event identities, or perform a separately validated rebuild.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while campaign selection or deduplication uses this state; do not discard credits merely because raw logs are large.

artifacts.purpose: Shared admission reservations, pacing and cooldown.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: All production admissions and safe retries.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore before dispatch; losing reservations is not a safe reset.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while active channels or retries can depend on reservations and cooldowns. Retire only after dispatch is stopped and all relevant windows and outcomes are resolved.

artifacts.purpose: Frozen intent, idempotency identity and per-item delivery receipts.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Resume, reconciliation and delayed observation credit.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore exact run records with matching events and state.

retention_rule.rule: Keep unresolved runs and all runs referenced by retained observations or required delivery evidence. Completed runs may retire only after these dependencies end.

artifacts.purpose: Exclusive writers and unresolved transaction markers.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Concurrent writer exclusion and recovery.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Reconcile commit and provider outcomes before removing stale locks.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while a writer is active or the transaction outcome is unresolved.

artifacts.purpose: Currently provisioned channel credentials.
artifacts.schema: CONFIG.md; selected provider or email-helper contract.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The selected channel adapter or external credential bridge.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore via the approved private credential backup or reauthorize.

retention_rule.rule: Keep current credentials required by active channels or recovery; remove replaced credentials only after rotation is confirmed.

artifacts.purpose: Exclusive temporary bytes before atomic runtime state publication.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The current atomic replacement transaction.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Reconstruct only from reconciled final state and retained inputs after checking whether the previous replacement committed.

retention_rule.rule: Normal completion removes staging files. After interruption, remove only after the writer stops and the final state, required inputs and commit outcome are known.

artifacts.purpose: Selected companion-specific credential and configuration application bridge.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The source apply command delegates to this exact companion helper; provisioning and restoration workflows also select it.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the reviewed companion version and validate any replacement against the selected apply interface.

retention_rule.rule: Preserve while the selected apply or restoration workflow depends on this helper. Its interface role does not prove matching templates exist or provisioning succeeds.

artifacts.purpose: Selected companion credential provisioning helper.
artifacts.schema: Companion provisioning runbooks and secrets/README.md; the helper writes selected private credential files.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Reviewed credential capture and the following configuration application step.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the reviewed helper with its selected private credential backup or reauthorization procedure.

retention_rule.rule: Preserve while current provisioning or restoration instructions select this helper. Retire only after those instructions and a validated replacement agree.

artifacts.purpose: Legacy MCP listing and registry.tools verifier superseded by current validation interfaces.
artifacts.schema: Legacy helper expects registry.tools and a separate functional-test.py; current channel configuration uses registry.channels.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: No current selected workflow; current restoration uses the source doctor and companion apply.py --verify.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Use the current source doctor and selected companion application checks; retain any required diagnostic evidence separately.

retention_rule.rule: Eligible only for a separately reviewed exact-file retirement after inactivity and recovery checks. Classification does not authorize automatic deletion or execute the helper.

artifacts.purpose: Private compliance decisions retained for reconciliation with current dispatch policy.
artifacts.schema: Legacy companion compliance-policy document; current runtime reads product.compliance and channel policies.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Compliance review and reconciliation of prior policy obligations.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the reviewed private policy with the consent and suppression evidence it references.

retention_rule.rule: Preserve until its unique decisions and referenced obligations have been reconciled with current policy. This declaration does not make the legacy document an active runtime policy.

artifacts.purpose: Existing consent-source records retained for obligation review.
artifacts.schema: Legacy JSONL records with lawful_basis, captured_at, source and evidence; differs from current latest-row consent schema.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Review of consent provenance and any continuing contact obligations.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore exact records from private history; migrate only after the evidence and current consent requirements are reconciled.

retention_rule.rule: Keep records while their evidence or obligations remain relevant. A template suffix does not prove synthetic content, current consent or safe retirement.

artifacts.purpose: Companion setup rationale that can be replaced by current source operating guidance.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Companion-maintainer setup reference.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recreate minimal current guidance from the source and retain any unique required decision before replacement.

retention_rule.rule: Replace obsolete copied guidance after checking for unique decisions and current references; keep current instructions in the source.

artifacts.purpose: Historical companion-scaffolding release notes.
artifacts.schema: Markdown release notes for the initial companion scaffolding.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: No current runtime reader; the source owns current release and operating instructions.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Read the existing private revision if historical scaffolding details are needed.

retention_rule.rule: Eligible only after historical-reference dependencies are released and a separate exact-file retirement is reviewed; no automatic deletion is authorized.
